svg.text: Desktop Assistant - Actual placement / two-layer route candidate
TOP red / BOTTOM blue / through-hole pads gold | 12 mil signals, 40 mil 5V/GND, 24 mil 3V3, 8 mil clearance | file units: mil
U-notch: x 0..24.17 mm, y 9.5..22.5 mm. Holes: diameter 3.2 mm; dashed rings = 2.5 mm screw-head radius. Edge: 12 mil.
Pad geometry and positions come from pcb-placed-pads.json. Empty-net pads remain copper obstacles. Magenta dashed lines = disconnected groups.
Offline candidate only. Independent continuous geometry audit performed; native EDA DRC and fabrication checks remain required.
